rateLimits.note: "more than 600 requests in the same minute will result in a 30 min ban" (fair use, per IP: the server's).
"more than 10 credentials attempts in the same minute, either valid or invalid, will result in a 1 min ban" (POST /auth/access_token).

provenance.notes: Legacy API (api.weezevent.com), access limited to registered Weezevent partners. Fair use: store what is read, filter queries (last_update for participants), keep the token on the server; Weezevent monitors calls and may limit or ban a key that does not use the API fairly. The limits are per IP and may change without notice. 5 invalid credentials in a row ban for 30 minutes (429): not a count the schema expresses. "token" is the provider's own access token request (username and password), guarded inside its operations (Config::guard()); a site giving access_token makes none. Each call counts one listing, not its pages. Commercial use, caching, redistribution and attribution: not addressed.
